items.reopen_condition: No new transport dependency unless product scope needs it. Preserve the existing packaged-stream owner and avoid conflating evolving protocol behavior with standards guarantees.

proposal_contract.Proposed mechanism: For a declared live-latency policy, stop consuming superseded media groups and select a valid newer random-access group. Tie subscription demand to active playback, not unconditional producer work.
proposal_contract.Smallest useful experiment: Delay one group while delivering later groups, pause/resume the consumer and vary queue pressure. Run a separate strict-VOD control that must not use lossy skipping.
proposal_contract.Correctness gate: No display of dependent frames without their closure; skipped intervals reported; timeline and audio/subtitles resynchronize; VOD control retains required content.
proposal_contract.Measure only after correctness: Live lateness and stale-work reduction under explicit loss policy, not equal-output CPU savings.

items.title: Publish narrow contracts for prepared-media reuse and virtual presentations
items.finding: Engine preparation already shares immutable assets and preview work has separate owners. R018 owns source/recipe prepared-media caching and the unified study owns engine sharing. Neither is evidence for sharing live parsers or clocks between export and playback.
items.novelty: Merge into R018; retain engine-sharing links without counting their savings again or inventing a universal graph.
items.next_action: When a repeated-preparation workload warrants integration, key reuse by immutable source, selected tracks, recipe, metadata epoch, destination and runtime; test individual invalidations and consumer cancellation, then charge retained memory and cold preparation.
items.reopen_condition: This is not a license to construct a universal graph engine. Reuse existing R018/mpv/FFmpeg facilities first; stop if bookkeeping exceeds saved preparation.

proposal_contract.Proposed mechanism: Separate source identity, selected tracks, transform recipe, metadata epoch and destination representation in reusable prepared state. Share immutable work while keeping live parser/decoder clocks independent.
proposal_contract.Smallest useful experiment: Open the same source for playback, preview and export; vary one track, recipe or destination at a time. Force cancellation of one consumer and source identity change.
proposal_contract.Correctness gate: Reuse only when dependencies match, no stale timeline state, original payload checks pass, and selected owners remain isolated through failure.
proposal_contract.Measure only after correctness: Repeated preparation, distinct assets/compilations and source reads, with retained-memory and invalidation cost.
